fields.why: Every quantity (Rockland 60%, national 93.4%, seroconversion, adverse-event ranges) is cited from earlier reports; under v5 a report of cited figures only gets outcome_types [].
Cited figures only: analytic_depth [] as for none; the Rockland vs national coverage contrast is cited, not computed by the report.
Method fields describe only what the article itself computes; the 60% vs 93.4% coverage contrast is two cited figures, so no own comparison.
The report summarizes the ACIP Evidence to Recommendations review ('This report summarizes evidence considered'); v5 puts EtR summaries inside guidance under review or synthesis.
